subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Place the yellow tape measure in its matching square recess at the back right of the toolbox.
Pick up the adjustable wrench from the left side of the toolbox with the left gripper and lay it flat across its matching long recess.

Use the right gripper to lift the yellow-handled pliers from the right side of the tray, turn them to match the plier-shaped recess at the back, and lay them flat in it. Withdraw the left arm clear of the toolbox.
Fully open both grippers, withdraw the right arm clear of the toolbox, and return both arms to their respective starting poses.
